description.value: Weaver Creek Spawning Channel is a federally operated salmon enhancement facility run by Fisheries and Oceans Canada, located along Morris Valley Road near Harrison Mills. It is one of BC's most accessible spots to witness Pacific salmon returning to spawn, drawing visitors each autumn to observe thousands of sockeye and other salmon. For touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley, it offers a striking natural spectacle in a rural setting alongside quiet backroads.
